name: Theresia II: Dear Lizst
summary:
Theresia II: Dear Lizst is a Japanese psychological horror adventure game developed by WorkJam for NTT DoCoMo's i-mode mobile phones. It is the second installment in the Theresia series and is no longer available following the discontinuation of its mobile distribution service.

The protagonist awakens in a deserted underground chamber with no memory of his past. As he explores the surrounding passages and an old castle, he discovers diary entries written by five women, offering clues to his forgotten identity and the events that brought him there.
